title: Electric Easter Egg Portrait
description: A surreal cracked egg with a female face, pink and blue hair, bunny ears, and a curly mustache, mounted on a golden stand inside a transparent glowing sphere. Blue and purple lightning bolts crackle across the sphere's surface against a dark background.
prompt: A surreal cracked egg with a feminine face, bright blue eyes, long eyelashes, pink and blue hair, large glowing bunny ears, and a prominent black mustache, mounted on an ornate golden goblet stand. The entire object is enclosed within a transparent spherical bubble that crackles with bright blue and purple electrical energy bolts, set against a deep black void with faint purple light streaks.
